250310101.text: This is bad... This is really bad...

250310102.text: Something gone wrong with Alem's training?

250310104.text: There's no time to explain. Please help me save her!

250310107.text: I—I guess you could say that. We've both broken down several times over our theses, even cried our hearts out in the library together...

250310108.text: Aaaah, but now's not the time for all this! She just wouldn't listen to me!

250310109.text: She said she'd do anything for her thesis, then set off with that guard of hers, rambling about the wilderness together for who knows how long!

250310110.text: But she still hasn't come back! And the tribe can't spare anyone to go rescue her...

250310111.text: #Please, {NICKNAME}, you have to go save her!

250310301.text: Worst comes to worst, can't you just... not finish writing the thesis? Aaaah—

250310401.text: Thank you, thanks for your help...

250310402.text: If I could have gotten rid of that damn bag earlier, I would have taken care of them all by myself.

250310403.text: No way! Then we'd have come to Natlan for nothing!

250310405.text: #Huh? Y—You're {NICKNAME}, aren't you? It's really you!

250310406.text: This lady next to you, surely it's not...

250310407.text: Narzam, Treasure Hoarder. We've met before. You haven't forgotten, have you?

250310408.text: Phew... You really are my savior! How many times have you saved me now? Once, twice...

250310409.text: I hope you're not counting that time you were with me. That happened because you insisted on staying.

250310410.text: Of course I'm not counting that time. And what do you mean I insisted on staying? I already paid you!

250310411.text: Yeah, just about enough to cover food and drinks...

250310412.text: Don't tell me you're here for your thesis again?

250310413.text: Hehe, well... Given the countless hours of hard work I've put into it, I couldn't just let it all go to waste, could I...

250310414.text: I applied for special funding from the Akademiya this time, and I even settled on a research topic as original as it gets.

250310415.text: Besides, I have Narzam with me as my guard. She's chased all the bad guys away.

250310416.text: Probably more just the fact that we're not carrying anything valuable enough to make it worth their while...

250310419.text: ...All this way, right from when we set out from the Children of Echoes, this girl's been clutching that bag with all her documents in as if it were a baby.

250310420.text: To be honest, even to me, she looks like some fool clinging on to treasure.

250310421.text: And someone carrying treasure, walking through an empty wilderness with only a single guard to protect her... Who wouldn't give that a try?

250310422.text: Well, you're right about one thing... My bag is indeed full of treasure! Not only does it contain all my field interview records, but copies of various documents too.

250310423.text: Armed with treasures like these, I'll have no problem writing my thesis!

250310424.text: And my chosen topic — the "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame." It's a subject of great importance, so I'll surely be able to graduate.

250310425.text: Oh, and of course, I couldn't have done it without Tahmures. This was her idea in the first place! She really is a great friend, teehee...

250310426.text: #Thank you once again, {NICKNAME}. If it wasn't for you, those bad guys would not only have ruined my books, they'd have stolen my money too!

250310427.text: A while back, I finally managed to earn a bit of pocket money by helping organize some books and materials. If it had been stolen, I wouldn't be able to afford any new materials myself.

250310428.text: True, but you'd end up spending all your money on books regardless. If I hadn't confiscated your wallet, we'd have gone hungry for sure...

250310429.text: I—I don't buy that many books... do I...?

250310430.text: Anyway, that's enough talk for now. We still need to head over to the People of the Springs to gather materials.

250310431.text: Goodbye then! My thesis shall be finished next we meet — I guarantee it! And when that time comes, I'll treat you to a delicious meal!

250310504.text: Phew... I was worried sick. If you'd have taken any longer, I'd have set off searching myself!

250310505.text: Couldn't that fool have picked a slightly simpler topic? With her ability, I'm sure she'd still get a high enough grade to graduate.

250310506.text: She always chooses such huge topics, does heaps of preparation, then ends up with nothing to show for it.

250310507.text: Apologies... I'm letting myself get carried away. Thank you for your help. Please, take these as payment.

250310508.text: *sigh* That halfwit... Why does she always make things so difficult for herself...
